criteria.requirement: Add ConfigObj.validate_report(validator, *, apply=False) using actual validate(preserve_errors=True) and flatten_errors. Always return JSON-safe valid:boolean, issues:[{path:list,kind:string}], changed_paths, defaulted_paths and applied. valid must only accept the literal successful True result, never a truthy failure dict. Report complete nested paths and error class/missing markers without error messages or configuration values. Default dry mode validates a raw-preserving clone and leaves source values/comments/options unchanged; explicit apply=True uses existing validation conversion behavior. Record type conversions and applied default paths, keeping validate API unchanged.
